milestones.title: M0 - Source Reconciliation and Governance
milestones.description: Audit and reconcile Athena chats, media, decisions, scope, and public-mirror governance.

milestones.title: M1 - Brain Stem and Continuity
milestones.description: Implement the governed two-way chat/repository loop, context capsules, schemas, and CI.

milestones.title: M2 - Distributed Cognitive Fabric
milestones.description: Build model adapters, Athena Highway contracts, project capsules, routing, and conformance tests.

milestones.title: M3 - Evidence, Cognition, and Memory
milestones.description: Connect claims, evidence labels, cognitive outputs, semantic revision, and memory writeback.

milestones.title: M4 - Operative Duplex
milestones.description: Specify and prove a bounded independent operative AI with Pilot/Witness and Cartographer slices.

milestones.title: M5 - Nexus-V Semantic Execution
milestones.description: Trace Plan intent to Nexus-V implementation and establish reproducible semantic execution regressions.

milestones.title: M6 - OASIS Reality Compiler
milestones.description: Build a calibrated sensing, material behavior, environment compilation, and inverse-design proof path.

milestones.title: M7 - Lightcore Research
milestones.description: Develop an evidence-gated physical execution profile and bounded optical experiments.

milestones.title: M8 - Operator Experience and Release
milestones.description: Provide GitHub planning, operator observability, contribution, release, handoff, and recovery workflows.

issues.title: Complete official ChatGPT export reconciliation for Project Athena
issues.body:
## Outcome
Reconcile the current five-chat audited cache against an official account export without publishing unrelated account data.

## Scope
- Filter to the Project Athena conversations.
- Preserve alternate branches exposed by the export.
- Compare conversation IDs, messages, media references, attachments, and timestamps.
- Record deleted or unavailable material as unproven.

## Done when
- A source-bundle manifest and comparison report exist.
- Every mismatch has a disposition.
- Complete account fidelity is either supported or remains explicitly not proven.

issues.title: Enforce the public-mirror publication and privacy gate
issues.body:
## Outcome
Make reviewed Athena material publishable while preventing credentials, account-wide exports, private conversations, and unreviewed personal data from entering the public repository.

## Done when
- Policy is canonical and machine-readable.
- CI scans for common credential patterns.
- Local-only import paths are ignored.
- A release or push checklist names the publication review.

issues.title: Finish storyboard semantic review and contradiction register
issues.body:
## Outcome
Review all 58 recovered images for architecture claims, generation defects, duplicates, obsolete labels, and contradictions with current Plan text.

## Done when
- Every asset has a semantic disposition.
- Composite crops and text defects are labeled.
- Useful concepts are linked to canonical text rather than promoted by image alone.

issues.title: Harden chat export import, normalization, and deduplication
issues.body:
## Outcome
Provide a repeatable local importer for the audited JSONL cache and official ChatGPT exports.

## Done when
- Source scope and SHA-256 are recorded.
- Current and alternate branch messages are distinguishable.
- Duplicate IDs are handled deterministically.
- Unreviewed output remains outside Git.
- Fixtures cover malformed, duplicate, branched, and media-only turns.

issues.title: Generate bounded and full repository-to-chat context capsules
issues.body:
## Outcome
Export current repository authority, work, decisions, evidence posture, and hashes for future chat sessions.

## Done when
- Bounded output records every truncation.
- Full selected-text output is chunked and untruncated.
- Git state and source hashes are included.
- Raw transcripts and binaries are excluded by policy.
- A round-trip test shows the next session can identify current work and gaps.

issues.title: Add repository integrity and context CI
issues.body:
## Outcome
Run JSON, JSONL, PowerShell, manifest-path, asset-hash, publication-safety, and whitespace checks on pull requests and pushes.

## Done when
- CI fails on a deliberately broken fixture.
- Storyboard checksums are verified.
- Reports identify the failing file and check.
- The workflow needs no persistent external service credentials.

issues.title: Implement promotion-ledger review and writeback tooling
issues.body:
## Outcome
Turn source-only chat messages into reviewable proposals and accepted writebacks without automatic canonical mutation.

## Done when
- Promotion records validate against schema.
- Accepted records name reviewer, evidence, target files, and result.
- Rejected and superseded states remain queryable.
- A report finds accepted records without implementation evidence.

issues.title: Build adapter and project-capsule conformance fixtures
issues.body:
## Outcome
Prove adapter and project-capsule contracts with valid and invalid fixtures.

## Done when
- Identity, authority, read/write scope, lineage, evidence, and validation fields are exercised.
- Invalid authority escalation fails.
- Capsule revision and fork behavior is deterministic.
- Results are part of repository CI.

issues.title: Run a read-only Codex adapter docking proof
issues.body:
## Outcome
Demonstrate a model-local adapter loading a scoped Athena capsule, reading approved files, producing evidence, and writing only to an allowed work area.

## Done when
- Handshake and capability negotiation are logged.
- Unauthorized paths are rejected.
- Result and evidence return to central Athena.
- Model-local state is not treated as canonical.

issues.title: Specify Athena Highway message, error, and recovery semantics
issues.body:
## Outcome
Define versioned transport-neutral envelopes for identity, context, authority, capability, evidence, result, error, cancellation, and recovery.

## Done when
- Schemas and sequence examples exist.
- Replay and idempotency rules are explicit.
- Partial failure and stale-context behavior are testable.
- No protocol assumes a specific model vendor.

issues.title: Bind claims and cognition outputs to evidence and epistemic labels
issues.body:
## Outcome
Carry verified, plausible, speculative, contradicted, and needs-test labels with claims through reasoning and writeback.

## Done when
- Claim records reference evidence IDs.
- Unsupported speculation cannot update core memory as fact.
- Contradictions survive handoff.
- One failing-build example is replayed end to end.

issues.title: Implement semantic drift and non-monotonic revision records
issues.body:
## Outcome
Detect changed definitions or evidence and revise conclusions without erasing why the earlier conclusion existed.

## Done when
- Definition versions and dependent claims are linked.
- Retractions and supersessions preserve provenance.
- Drift checks produce actionable review items.
- Core identity and constitutional terms require elevated review.

issues.title: Close one full Athena task with verified memory writeback
issues.body:
## Outcome
Run a real task through intake, authority, evidence, cognition, execution, verification, audit, and memory writeback.

## Done when
- Every stage has a durable artifact.
- Facts, assumptions, and unknowns remain separate.
- The next context capsule reflects the completed result.
- A second agent can reconstruct the decision from repository evidence.

issues.title: Decide the Operative Duplex system name and identity boundary
issues.body:
## Outcome
Confirm or replace the provisional Operative Duplex name and define the independent system's mission, owner, memory, authority, and relationship to Athena.

## Done when
- A human decision is recorded.
- Identity and non-goals are canonical.
- Shared versus independent memory is explicit.
- No implementation file uses an unresolved identity assumption.

issues.title: Implement a read-only Operative Duplex Cartographer slice
issues.body:
## Outcome
Observe and model a bounded desktop or application surface without performing mutation.

## Done when
- Observation schema records source, time, confidence, and uncertainty.
- The application model is versioned.
- No action path is enabled.
- Replay demonstrates what was seen and what remained unknown.

issues.title: Prove Pilot and Witness separation for operative actions
issues.body:
## Outcome
Separate action proposal/execution from independent observation, policy checking, and verification.

## Done when
- The Witness can veto or require confirmation.
- Action records contain authority, expected effect, rollback, and proof.
- Failure and partial completion are represented.
- Audit evidence cannot be rewritten by the Pilot.

issues.title: Complete Nexus-V Plan-to-implementation traceability
issues.body:
## Outcome
Map every active Nexus-V Plan requirement to RTL, toolchain code, generated evidence, test status, or an explicit gap.

## Done when
- The implementation matrix names requirement IDs and file evidence.
- Generated artifacts are not treated as source authority.
- Unsupported completeness claims are removed.
- Missing tests become bounded issues.

issues.title: Establish reproducible NVASM, NVIR, and NVOBJ regressions
issues.body:
## Outcome
Make the semantic toolchain bridge reproducible with versioned inputs and expected outputs.

## Done when
- Fixture programs cover parse, lower, encode, and failure paths.
- Output hashes or semantic assertions are checked.
- CI prerequisites are documented.
- Regression failures identify the stage and input.

issues.title: Provision and document the Nexus-V simulator and lint toolchain
issues.body:
## Blocker
A supported local simulator/linter path has not been selected and proven.

## Outcome
Provide a reproducible installation and invocation path for lint and regression.

## Done when
- Tool versions and licenses are recorded.
- A clean environment can run lint and one simulation.
- Failure logs are retained.
- The unblock decision is reflected in project context.

issues.title: Define OASIS observation, calibration, material, and environment schemas
issues.body:
## Outcome
Create versioned contracts for sensor observations, calibration, Material Behavioral Atlas records, environment packages, uncertainty, and provenance.

## Done when
- Schemas include units, coordinate frames, timestamps, calibration lineage, confidence, and missing-data behavior.
- Invalid fixtures fail.
- The contracts do not claim unsupported sensing fidelity.

issues.title: Run a calibrated RGB-depth tabletop environment proof
issues.body:
## Outcome
Capture a bounded tabletop scene and compile it into a versioned environment package with measurable uncertainty.

## Done when
- Calibration and capture procedure are reproducible.
- Source observations remain linked.
- Geometry and material assertions have confidence labels.
- A held-out measurement checks reconstruction error.

issues.title: Validate one constrained OASIS inverse-design candidate
issues.body:
## Outcome
Generate one candidate design from explicit target behavior and constraints, then validate it independently.

## Done when
- Objective, constraints, search space, and uncertainty are recorded.
- Candidate generation is separate from validation.
- Failure criteria are declared before testing.
- Result is labeled measured, inferred, or rejected.

issues.title: Implement a Nexus-V-compatible Lightcore software profile
issues.body:
## Outcome
Model Lightcore as an experimental execution profile that preserves Nexus-V state, audit, rollback, authority, and routing invariants before physical implementation claims.

## Done when
- Profile capabilities and limits are explicit.
- Reference software passes the same semantic fixtures.
- Unsupported physical behavior remains hypothetical.
- Divergence from the digital baseline is measurable.

issues.title: Run one bounded Lightcore optical-link experiment
issues.body:
## Outcome
Measure one narrowly defined optical or photonic interconnect behavior with calibration, controls, and failure criteria.

## Done when
- Apparatus, wavelength, power, geometry, sensors, and calibration are recorded.
- Safety constraints are reviewed.
- Raw measurements and analysis are preserved.
- The result does not generalize beyond the tested configuration.

issues.title: Build Athena operator health and evidence posture reporting
issues.body:
## Outcome
Give the operator a concise view of repository integrity, current milestone, blocked work, stale context, evidence gaps, and latest successful cycle.

## Done when
- Report is generated from repository state.
- Red, amber, and green conditions have explicit definitions.
- Links point to source evidence and work items.
- The report works locally and as a GitHub artifact.

issues.title: Run repository restore, handoff, and continuity drills
issues.body:
## Outcome
Prove that Athena can recover repository state, restore working context, and hand off to a fresh agent without relying on hidden session memory.

## Done when
- Restore runs against a disposable target.
- A fresh agent uses only repository context and the capsule.
- Time, gaps, and failures are recorded.
- Lessons update playbooks and milestone state.

issues.title: Create release, contribution, and GitHub Project operating rules
issues.body:
## Outcome
Make public collaboration predictable through issue forms, pull-request checks, CODEOWNERS, project views, release criteria, and evidence expectations.

## Done when
- Templates route architecture, implementation, and research work.
- Project fields and views match the desired-state blueprint.
- Release notes distinguish implemented, specified, and experimental work.
- Publication and provenance checks are required.
